instruction:
Apply a USB differential-pair ECO directly to the real Altium board file `C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\wifi_board.PcbDoc`, then save the modified native document as `C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\wifi_usb_eco.PcbDoc`.

Requirements:
- Change the footprints of both `R9` and `R10` to `RESC1005X40X25NL05T05`.
- Keep the footprint of `R11` unchanged.
- Rename net `PA12_USB_D_N` to `USB2_D_N` and `PA12_USB_D_P` to `USB2_D_P`.
- Update the `DiffPairsRouting` rule so its differential-pair scope becomes `InDifferentialPair('USB2_D')`.

Do not output an ECO-report JSON; the evaluation checks whether this ECO was actually applied to the native `.PcbDoc`.
source: Local Altium example `Mini PC - WiFi\WiFi.PcbDoc`; benchmark task restored from text-only ECO logging to native PCB ECO application.
